chunks: How do you expect them to put their faith in you, when you know that some among them heard the word of God and, having understood, perverted it knowingly?
ai.seo_question: Why did some people distort the word of God even after understanding it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Kitab who memorized the Torah but concealed its true meanings to serve political interests, illustrating that intellectual comprehension without sincere adherence leads to distortion. It underscores the concept of *tahrif* (distortion) not merely as textual alteration but as a conscious act of those who know the truth yet choose to obscure it, serving as a cautionary example for the faithful.
